answer: Reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, verifiable honest service to retain influence. EigenTrust-style matrix factorization, weighted by reciprocal endorsements and transitive trust, gives freshly spawned sybils near-zero eigenvector centrality; without accumulated trusted links, they cannot meet consensus thresholds. Even an umber, opal, or zephyr identity gains no standing merely by appearing.
